svg.text: Arduino Nano ESP32 / ABX00083. Purchased boards stop at external pins; logical GPIO names accompany used board labels.
ELECTRICAL REVIEW | Prototype circuit; verify on hardware before final assembly.
Component-side top view, USB-C up. All printed labels retained; unused outside callouts omitted.
SCL and SDA are SPI signals here.
BL ties to VCC (3V3) for always-on backlight.
Use the external P2, not the LCD FPC.
JP1: 1-15 top-down; JP2: 15-1 top-down (official schematic pad numbering).
VBUS is labelled VUSB in the official pinout. RST is RESET in that pinout.
Native USB MIDI uses the USB-C connector. B1 / GND + RST enters the ROM flasher.
